CHINA IS DUMPING US TREASURIES 

China, the 3rd-largest foreign holder of U.S. Treasuries, has cut its Treasury holdings by roughly $61 BILLION since February 2026.

Holdings fell from $694.2B in February → $633.4B in June, the lowest level since September 2008.

US HOUSING MARKET 

NUMBER OF HOME BUYERS FALLS TO THE LOWEST LEVEL EVER RECORDED 

The number of U.S. homebuyers fell to an estimated 966,752 in July 2026, the lowest level on record, as high home prices and mortgage rates push potential buyers to the sidelines.

US hiring plans continue to improve:

US-based employers announced plans to hire 12,325 workers in August, the strongest August total since 2022.

This marks a +725% increase from the 1,494 recorded in August 2025.

Aerospace and Defense led all industries, with 4,025 announced

JAPAN TURNS TO AI SATELLITES FOR FASTER DEFENSE RESPONSE

Japan plans to develop AI-powered satellites to speed up military counterstrike decisions, Nikkei reports.

The Defense Ministry will work with Japanese companies to build test satellites between fiscal 2027 and 2029.
